messages:
niki: FYI recruiters flagged ~30 interviews where the scorecard version is "legacy-v1" even though we migrated to v2 last month. Seems like the bulk import job didn't tag some loop-created interviews.

sam: saw that in the daily QA dashboard. Could be the CSV import mapping skipped the "scorecard_version" column.

olga: is this urgent? will existing feedback be lost if we force-update to v2?

sam: v1 -> v2 mapping is one-to-one for fields we use, but v1 has an extra section that v2 removed. if we change the link we risk orphaning notes in the extra section. prefer to attach v2 and preserve the old scorecard as read-only.

niki: proposal: 1) export affected interviews to CSV, 2) run a non-destructive backfill that creates a read-only alias to legacy v1 (scorecard_legacy_id) and sets scorecard_version=v2, 3) notify hiring managers.

olga: 👍 for non-destructive approach. can you post the CSV sample first?

sam: export command I used:

```
runbooks/ats_export.sh --from 2025-12-15 --to 2025-12-16 --filter "scorecard=legacy-v1" --out /tmp/legacy_hits.csv
```

recruiting-bot: export job queued (ex-99331). ETA 30s.

sam: sample rows (anonymized):
```
candidate_id,interview_id,role,created_by,scorecard_version
C-801,INT-210,Backend IC3,loop-recruiter,legacy-v1
C-802,INT-213,Frontend IC2,loop-recruiter,legacy-v1
```

niki: ok runbook for backfill (dry-run first):
```
python tools/scorecard_migrate.py --csv /tmp/legacy_hits.csv --dry-run --preserve-legacy
```

olga: suggest adding a flag `--notify-hiring-manager` so we auto-email the HM with a short note and link to the preserved legacy view.

sam: agree. also add a Slack alert to #people-ops with count and sample ids.

sam: dry-run results: 31 rows would be annotated with legacy alias and bumped to v2. no collisions.

niki: approved. run apply and include --notify-hiring-manager.

recruiting-bot: migrate job started (mg-99331).

niki: apply completed. job mg-99331 updated 31 interviews. See logs: https://internal.logs/ats/mg-99331

sam: log snippet:
```
2025-12-16T14:05:12Z INFO annotated INT-210 legacy_alias=legacy-v1-801
2025-12-16T14:05:13Z INFO updated INT-213 scorecard_version=v2
```

olga: spot-check 6 interviews: legacy notes accessible via read-only alias, v2 form present and scoring fields intact.

people-ops-admin: follow-ups: 1) update importer docs to include scorecard_version column and validation step; 2) schedule a 20-min recruiter office hours to walk through failure modes; 3) add a nightly QA that alerts if >5 interviews with legacy-v1 appear.

niki: I'll update the importer runbook and create a short checklist for recruiters. olga, can you own the office hours invite?

olga: will do. proposing Mon 9am next week.

people-ops-admin: thanks all. closing thread once runbook PR and calendar invite exist. :white_check_mark:
